sentences.text: HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE ANIL VERMA  ON THE 19 th OF SEPTEMBER, 2023

MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 40191 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 ABDUL REHMAN S/O RAHIM KHAN, AGED 25 YEARS,

OCCUPATION: LABOR R/O ALOTE TEHSIL ALOTE  DISTT. RATLAM (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI RITU RAJ BHATNAGAR - ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION ALOTE DISTRICT RATLAM (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 ( BY SHRI MUKESH SHARMA - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, th  following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 447/2023 registered at Police Station Alote District Ratlam (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 344, 366, 368, 376(2)(n), 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. As per prosecution story, on 3.7.2023 complainant lodged a missing person report which was registered as 41/2023 before police station Alote.
During investigation police recovered prosecutrix and recorded her statement in which she stated that she started talking to the applicant.
After sometime the prosecutrix went to village Banswara Rajasthan and reside there where the applicant committed rape upon her.
Accordingly, offence has been registered against the applicant.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is an innocent person and he has Abdul Rehman vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103001275/
1 been falsely implicated in this offence.

sentences.text: He is in custody since 11.7.2023.
The prosecutrix is a 20 years old major and married lady having one son.
She went with the applicant on her own accord.
MLC report is not supported the case of prosecution.
Investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed.
Applicant is permanent resident of Ratlam district.
Final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Under the above circumstances, prayer for grant of bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.
4. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.

5. Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case diary.
6.

After considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence,
arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant and also taking note of the fact that prosecutrix is a major and married lady having one child, she lived in the company of applicant for a period of 7 days and travelled with him so many places, investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE BDJ Abdul Rehman vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103001275/
